en.title: How close can a fraction get to π?
subtitle: A fraction can imitate pi astonishingly well. But a small error is only half the story.
The other half is the size of its denominator. How much accuracy can that denominator buy?
en.label: accuracy versus denominator

zh.title: 一个分数，能离 π 多近？
subtitle: 有些分数逼近圆周率，精确得惊人。但只看误差，还不够。
我们还要看分母有多大：付出这样的分母，换来了多少精度？
zh.label: 精度，与分母的代价

en.title: Two familiar approximations
subtitle: Twenty-two sevenths misses pi by about 0.00126449. The denominator is only seven.
With denominator 113, the fraction 355 over 113 has error about 0.000000266764.
That is remarkable. It is still a single approximation, not an infinite pattern.
en.label: The gaps below use different magnifications

zh.title: 两个熟悉的近似值
subtitle: 七分之二十二，与 π 相差约 0.00126449。它的分母只有 7。
分母变成 113，三百五十五除以一百一十三，误差只有约 0.000000266764。
这很惊人。但一个漂亮的近似值，还不是无穷多个近似值的规律。
zh.label: 下方两条误差线采用不同放大倍率

en.title: Compare powers, not just decimals
subtitle: Use the denominator q as a scale. Compare the error with one over q squared, or one over q to the power 2.5.
On logarithmic axes, these powers are straight lines. A dot below a line beats that benchmark at that denominator.
en.label: reference curves, not universal lower bounds

zh.title: 不只数小数位，还要比较幂次
subtitle: 把分母 q 当作尺度，将误差与 q 的负二次方、负二点五次方作比较。
在双对数坐标里，这些幂函数都是直线。一个点落在线下，就表示它在这个分母上胜过了对应尺度。
zh.label: 这些是比较基准，并非普遍的误差下界

en.title: The key phrase: infinitely many
subtitle: The irrationality exponent is the supremum of exponents nu for which infinitely many reduced fractions beat q to the minus nu.
A larger exponent means an even smaller target error. One spectacular fraction cannot decide this supremum.
en.label: p and q coprime; q ≥ 2; ν > 0

zh.title: 关键词：无穷多个
subtitle: 无理数指数，是这样一些指数 ν 的上确界：有无穷多个约分后的分数，误差小于 q 的负 ν 次方。
指数越大，要求的误差越小。再惊人的单个分数，也不能决定这个上确界。
zh.label: p、q 互素；q ≥ 2；ν > 0

en.title: Why the number 2 appears
subtitle: Take the fractional parts of zero, x, two x, all the way to N x. There are N plus one points in N equal boxes.
Two points share a box. Subtracting them gives integers p and q, with one at most q at most N, and error less than one over q N.
That is at most one over q squared. For irrational x, increasing N forces infinitely many distinct approximations. So the exponent is at least two.
en.label: Pigeonhole principle · irrational x

zh.title: 为什么偏偏是 2？
subtitle: 取 0、x、2x，一直到 Nx 的小数部分。把单位区间分成 N 格，却放进了 N＋1 个点。
必有两个点同格。相减后得到整数 p、q，其中 1 ≤ q ≤ N，且逼近误差小于 1／(qN)。
而 1／(qN) 不超过 1／q²。x 无理时，增大 N 会迫使不同的近似值无穷出现，所以无理数指数至少为 2。
zh.label: 鸽巢原理 · x 为无理数

en.title: What the repository claims for π
subtitle: The repository claims the matching upper bound. Choose any exponent nu strictly greater than two.
There is a threshold Q, allowed to depend on nu. Beyond it, every integer numerator p and every integer denominator q satisfy this inequality.
The paper does not give an effective value of Q. These quantifiers are the substance of the claim.
en.label: claimed theorem · threshold not given effectively

zh.title: 仓库对 π 声称了什么？
subtitle: 这个仓库声称补上了反方向。先任选一个严格大于 2 的指数 ν。
存在一个可以依赖 ν 的阈值 Q。只要整数分母 q ≥ Q，不论整数分子 p 是多少，都满足这条下界。
论文并未有效给出 Q 的数值。这些量词，才是这个主张的核心。
zh.label: 仓库主张 · 未有效给出阈值

en.title: Keep the boundary honest
subtitle: This is not a lower bound of one over q squared for every fraction. The example 355 over 113 already beats that.
Exponent two also does not imply a fixed positive constant c giving a c over q squared bound. And it is not a faster algorithm for computing pi.
en.label: μ(π) = 2 does not imply a uniform c/q² bound

zh.title: 边界，不能偷换
subtitle: 这不表示每个分数的误差都至少是 1／q²。三百五十五除以一百一十三，就已经小于这个值。
指数等于 2，也不推出存在固定正数 c 的 c／q² 下界。它同样不是一种更快计算 π 的算法。
zh.label: μ(π)＝2 不推出统一的 c／q² 下界

en.title: The paper's claimed proof strategy
subtitle: Suppose a fixed exponent above two could be beaten at arbitrarily large denominators. Select well-separated good approximations.
The paper uses a multivariable interpolation theorem to build a matrix with a nonzero rational-complex determinant.
en.label: a roadmap, not a verification of the proof

zh.title: 论文声称的证明路线
subtitle: 反过来，假设某个大于 2 的固定指数，能被任意大分母的近似值击败。挑选一组尺度分离的好近似。
论文用多变量插值定理，构造一个矩阵，使它的一个取值于有理复数的行列式不为零。
zh.label: 这是证明路线图，不是对证明的独立核验

en.title: One determinant, incompatible bounds
subtitle: Clear denominators. A nonzero Gaussian integer has absolute value at least one. This creates an arithmetic lower bound for the original determinant.
The claimed analytic estimate uses the tiny approximation errors and cancellations to force the same determinant below that lower bound.
If both bounds and nonvanishing hold, the assumed infinite supply of exceptional approximations is impossible.
en.label: schematic comparison · not the paper's exact estimates

zh.title: 同一个行列式，两道矛盾的界
subtitle: 清除分母后，非零高斯整数的绝对值至少为 1，于是原行列式得到一个算术下界。
论文声称的解析估计，利用微小的逼近误差与消去现象，将同一个行列式压到该下界之下。
如果非零性和两侧估计都成立，原先假设的无穷多个超常近似就不可能存在。
zh.label: 仅为结构示意，未展示论文的精确估计

en.title: Where the real difficulty lives
subtitle: More unknowns than constraints does not, by itself, prove that the special interpolation matrix has full rank.
The paper's crucial claim is an interpolation result with thresholds independent of the center locations. That prevents circular choices. This is a major step to audit.
en.label: Full rank needs a theorem, not a dimension count

zh.title: 真正的困难，藏在这里
subtitle: 未知数比约束多，并不能自动证明这个特殊插值矩阵满秩。
论文关键主张，是阈值不依赖中心位置的插值定理。这样选择参数才不会循环依赖；这也是需要重点核查的一步。
zh.label: 维数计数，并不自动保证满秩

en.title: What has actually been checked?
subtitle: The repository contains a paper and Lean and Comparator files stating the same complete target. We checked the displayed statement and its quantifiers.
We have not independently compiled the formalization or validated every proof step. This review animation does not establish peer-reviewed acceptance.
en.label: source snapshot: openai/math · adc7f1241b42

zh.title: 目前，到底核查了什么？
subtitle: 仓库提供了论文，以及陈述同一完整目标的 Lean 和 Comparator 文件。我们检查了所展示命题与量词的一致性。
我们没有独立编译形式化工程，也没有逐步验证整份证明。这份审稿动画不能代表学界或同行评审的认可。
zh.label: 来源快照：openai/math · adc7f1241b42

en.title: One great fraction is a moment
subtitle: An irrationality exponent describes an infinite pattern. For the claim mu of pi equals two, remember: every exponent above two, eventually.
en.label: An exponent describes an infinite pattern

zh.title: 一个好分数，是一个瞬间
subtitle: 无理数指数，描述的却是无穷序列的规律。理解 μ(π)＝2 的主张，请记住：每个大于 2 的指数，都有一个“从此以后”。
zh.label: 一个无理数指数，描述无穷的规律
